2. **Host allowlist**: 421 `INVALID_HOST` unless Host is in `security.allowedHosts`.

## 2. WorkflowService — `src/server/workflow/service.ts`

```ts
export interface ActionResult { project: Project; duplicate: boolean; }
export class WorkflowService {
  async get(): Promise<Project>                       // store.load().state (no lock)
  withLock<T>(work: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T>     // AsyncLock — serializes mutation + native call
  async execute(actionId, payload, expectedRevision, mutation): Promise<ActionResult>  // withLock(executeLocked)
  async executeLocked(actionId, payload, expectedRevision, mutation)
  async ensureRuntimeMetadata(mode, workspace): {updated:boolean}
  async recoverAfterRestart(): Promise<{recovered:number} | null>
  async executeLatest(actionId, payload, mutation): Promise<ActionResult>  // background completions
}
```

- **`execute` semantics**: idempotency by `actionId`. Existing action with matching `payloadHash` → returns `{project, duplicate:true}` (dedupe replay); existing with **different** payloadHash → `RevisionConflict("Action ID was already used with a different payload.")`; revision mismatch → `RevisionConflict("Expected revision N, found M.")`. On success: mutation applied, action record pushed (`{id, payloadHash, resultRevision: expectedRevision+1, createdAt}`), retention applied, `store.save(expectedRevision, retained)`.
- **`executeLatest`** (used by background run completion/cancel): no expectedRevision; up to **5 retry attempts** optimistic-concurrency loop; duplicate-payload → `duplicate:true`; reused actionId with different payload → `RevisionConflict("Background action ID was reused with a different payload.")`; after 5 conflicts → `RevisionConflict("Background update could not be applied to the latest project revision.")`. Doc quote: *"A long native run must not be tied to the revision that queued it... This retries optimistic concurrency conflicts a bounded number of times and never repeats the native operation itself."*
- **`recoverAfterRestart`** (startup recovery of "unknown outcomes"): every operation with status in `["QUEUED","RUNNING","WAITING_PERMISSION"]` → `status="ABANDONED"`, `statusReason="application-restarted"`, `result="The application restarted while this native operation was in flight. It was not repeated; reconcile the native session."`, transcript system entry logged, `refreshNextAction` run. Wired in `src/server/index.ts:50` (`startupRecovery = await workflow.recoverAfterRestart()`; log label `interrupted_operations_marked_unknown`).

`RevisionConflict` is defined in **`src/server/store/atomic-project-store.ts:19`** (`export class RevisionConflict extends Error {}`); `store.save(expectedRevision, project)` throws it on optimistic concurrency failure, `store.load()` returns `LoadResult {state, source, corruptPath?, quarantinePath?, migrated?, fromVersion?}`.

### `refreshNextAction` — `src/server/workflow/model.ts:347`

This is the single source of truth for stage + blocked-progress strings. Priority order:

1. First non-`APPROVED` section → sets `currentSectionId`.
2. **Any operation with unresolved status `QUEUED | RUNNING | WAITING_PERMISSION | COMPLETED_UNAPPLIED | ABANDONED` blocks ALL progress.** Stage becomes `MAKER`/`WITNESS`/`ARCHITECT` per `operation.kind`, and `nextAction` is one of:
   - `WAITING_PERMISSION`: `"A native permission is pending. Resolve it in OpenCode, then reconcile. Work will not be repeated automatically."`
   - `RUNNING`: `"A native run is still running. Wait or reconcile. It will not be started again automatically."`
   - `COMPLETED_UNAPPLIED`: `"A native result arrived after the active request ended. Review and apply or discard it before any new run."`
   - otherwise (`QUEUED`/`ABANDONED`): `"A native run was abandoned without a confirmed outcome. Reconcile it before any new run."`
3. Product not approved → stage `ORACLE`; `PROPOSED` → `"Approve the Oracle proposal, or ask a question"`, else `"Describe an idea and wake the Oracle"`.
4. Current section unresolved → stage `ARCHITECT`; `"Draft "<title>` or `"Review "<title>` (DRAFT/STALE).
5. All sections approved but `makerScope.status !== "GRANTED"` → `"Grant a separate Maker execution scope"`.
6. No `SUCCEEDED` maker operation yet → stage `MAKER`: `"Run the approved Maker unit and inspect the result"`.
7. Else stage `WITNESS`: `"Review the Witness drafts"` / `"Ask the Witness to review the evidence"`.

Also in `model.ts`: `createProject(workspace, mode, options)` (8 fixed sections control→readiness with dependency graph; stage `ORACLE`; capabilities `inspect-changes` + `node-check`), `payloadHash` (sha256 of canonicalized sorted-keys JSON), `migrateProject` (v1/v2/v3→**CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION 4**; v1/v2 legacy `UNKNOWN` operation status → `ABANDONED`, `statusReason:"legacy-unknown-outcome"`).

### `runs.ts` — `MakerRunCoordinator` (background run engine)
- `start(MakerRunInput)` fires `execute` detached; in-process map `activeRuns: Map<operationId, {sessionId, cancelled}>` is the "active" source for `GET /api/runs/:id` and cancel. Only in-memory; persistence is authoritative across restarts (quote: *"Persisted operation state remains the source of truth across process restarts; an interrupted process leaves a reconciled ABANDONED record rather than silently replaying the native action."*).
- Lifecycle: QUEUED → `update("start")` → RUNNING (result: `"Running in OpenCode with <provider>/<id>."`) → `guide.perform({role:"maker", …, onSession})` recording `nativeSessionId` ("Running in OpenCode session X"); then terminal classification:
  - `active.cancelled` → **CANCELLED**.
  - `performed.pendingPermission` → **WAITING_PERMISSION** ("A native permission request is pending. Resolve it in OpenCode, then reconcile. The run was not repeated.").
  - `timedOut || outcome running|unknown` → **ABANDONED** ("The native Maker run did not become idle before the deadline. It was not repeated; reconcile before another run.").
  - edited (diff non-empty) → **SUCCEEDED** (diff in result, then `runApprovedNodeCheck` traced via `traceToolOperation("maker",…,"node.test",…)`, appending `"Node check exit 0/…"`, pushing evidence `checkId:"CK-06"` PASS/FAIL and flipping `node-check`/`inspect-changes` capability availability).
  - else → **FAILED**.
- `markFailed`: status `failureIsUncertain(msg, err) ? ABANDONED : FAILED`; `failureIsUncertain` = true for codes `BUDGET_EXCEEDED`/`NATIVE_TIMEOUT`, any `error.nativeSessionId`, or message matching `/timed out|timeout|ECONN|fetch|network|socket|unavailable|interrupted/i` — i.e. uncertain failures never claim FAILED.
- `finish(...)` uses `workflow.executeLatest("run:<op>:finish", …)` and honors a prior CANCELLED state (merges late diff into the cancel note). All writes go through `refreshNextAction`. `providerErrorFor` classifies via `classifyProviderError` excluding internal codes (`BUDGET_EXCEEDED, NATIVE_TIMEOUT, MODEL_CHANGED, EMPTY_RESPONSE, ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE, ENGINE_INCOMPATIBLE, ENGINE_AUTH`).

- `ExperienceFailure(message, code, status, retryable, operationId=null, providerError=null)` (line 35) — the typed failure surfaced by `workflowError` in app.ts.

## Notable facts for the caller
- **Polling, not SSE, in the browser**: 1.5 s `loadProject()` interval while any op is `RUNNING | QUEUED` (WorkshopPage.tsx:70-78). Server SSE `/api/events` (5 s snapshot loop, cap 4 streams) exists but has no web client usage — only server tests use it (`tests/http-hardening.test.ts:209-221`).
- **No "unknown operation" recovery HTTP route exists** other than `GET /api/runs/:id` (returns 404 `RUN_NOT_FOUND` + `active` flag) and `POST /api/runs/:id/reconcile`; ABANDONED marking happens server-side in `WorkflowService.recoverAfterRestart()` at boot (`src/server/index.ts:50`).
- Client can never start a new run while one is unresolved — enforced both by `runMaker`'s `RUN_UNRESOLVED` 409 and by `refreshNextAction` pinning stage/nextAction to the unresolved operation until reconcile/cancel.
